# app/models/concerns/archivable.rb
module Archivable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    scope :active, -> { where(archived: false) }
  end

  def archive!
    update!(archived: true)
  end
end

# app/models/article.rb
class Article < ApplicationRecord
  include Archivable
end

# app/models/order.rb
class Order < ApplicationRecord
  include Archivable
end
